Name: OBJ_ACT_PARAM_ST
Description: Object actions: the interactions on assets such as doors, levers, chests and elevators. The row is the ObjAct ID given when the action is set up on the asset; −1 uses the asset's own default, else row 10000. Holds the prompt and failure messages, the condition, the animations, the event timing and the pre-action SFX.

Fields.Name: Action Enabled - Message ID
Fields.Description: Text shown for the action prompt (Action Button Text). −1: none.

Fields.Name: Action Failed - Message ID
Fields.Description: Text shown when the action is attempted but the condition is not met (Action Button Text). −1: none.

Fields.Name: Condition Bypass Flag
Fields.Description: While this event flag is on, the condition (Qualified ID Type [1]/[2]) is skipped and the action always succeeds. 0: no bypass.

Fields.Name: Player Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation the player plays for the action. Some object types add an offset (for example by the side the object is used from).

Fields.Name: Character Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation a non-player character plays for the action. Some object types add an offset as for Player Animation ID.

Fields.Name: Valid Distance
Fields.Description: Distance in cm (150 = 1.5 m). The character slides into the action position; the slide takes its full time from this distance or farther, proportionally less when closer.

Fields.Name: (DEPRECATED) Conditional Qualified ID [1]
Fields.Description: Old 16-bit form of Conditional Qualified ID [1].

Fields.Name: (DEPRECATED) Conditional Qualified ID [2]
Fields.Description: Old 16-bit form of Conditional Qualified ID [2].

Fields.Name: Object Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly on the object that marks the action position. Some object types add a fixed offset per approach side.

Fields.Name: Sync Event Trigger
Fields.Description: When on, the action's event is triggered through the synchronised path at the Event Execution Timing.

Fields.Name: Object Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation the object plays for the action. Some object types add an offset as for Player Animation ID.

Fields.Name: Valid Player Angle
Fields.Description: The effective angle of the player's action. Effective angle difference between the player's orientation vector and the orientation vector to the object

Fields.Name: Qualified ID Type [1]
Fields.Description: Condition type for Conditional Qualified ID [1]. None: the action has no condition. Goods: the player must have that item in the inventory (non-player characters fail). SpEffect: the acting character must have that SpEffect active. The action succeeds if condition [1] or condition [2] is met.

Fields.Name: Qualified ID Type [2]
Fields.Description: Condition type for Conditional Qualified ID [2], checked when condition [1] is not met. None: no second condition. Goods and SpEffect work as for Qualified ID Type [1].

Fields.Name: Valid Object Angle
Fields.Description: The action effective angle of the object. Effective angle difference between the action vector of the object and the character vector

Fields.Name: Character Absorb Type
Fields.Description: How the character is aligned to the action position during the action.

Fields.Name: Event Execution Timing
Fields.Description: When the action's synchronised event is triggered: before the animation plays (at the start of the action) or after it finishes.

Fields.Name: Action Button Param ID
Fields.Description: ActionButtonParam row for the action prompt. −1: no prompt is registered.

Fields.Name: Treasure Enable Delay
Fields.Description: Treasure objects only: seconds after the action before the treasure becomes available.

Fields.Name: Pre-action SFX Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Object dummy poly the pre-action SFX is spawned at. −1, or no dummy poly with this ID: the object's origin.

Fields.Name: Pre-action SFX ID
Fields.Description: SFX spawned on the object before the action. −1: none.
